connection: stdlib sqlite3; a fresh connection is opened and closed for every database operation in db.py
queries: The alert scan issues one query for the city/user join and then one conditions lookup per city, so N+1 lookups on the scan path
n_plus_one: Yes: run_alert_scan loops over cities and calls get_city_conditions once per city
concurrency: single-process CLI scan, no concurrency concerns

optimization_targets.description: Replace per-city condition lookups with a single batched query for all city ids
Add a short TTL cache for condition rows so repeat scans do not re-query the same cities

notes: The scan runs on a fixed schedule; city count can reach hundreds, so batching and a brief cache should cut the query count per scan to a constant.
